draft.headline: Synthetic Portfolio Operational Review

observations.interpretation: Observed email click performance reflects delivered messages with qualifying clicks relative to total delivered messages, noting that known bot clicks are excluded and repeat clicks collapse to message IDs.
Observed engagement rate captures eligible landing sessions meeting qualifying duration, pageview, or registration criteria relative to eligible landing sessions.
Observed registration rate indicates eligible landing sessions resulting in a registration relative to total eligible landing sessions, noting that tracking limitations split the hepatitis journey.
Observed attendance rate measures distinct registered webinar or person pairs with positive attendee time relative to total distinct registrations, with rejoins collapsed and presenters excluded.

actions: Review and add explicit mapping for unmapped hepatitis campaign tags in web exports, preserving original raw tags.
Skip identical webinar export files and count distinct webinar or person pairs rather than attendance rows.
Edit WordPress landing page asset metadata to unhide registration actions at narrow widths and run a fresh mobile test journey.

draft.headline: Synthetic hepatitis portfolio observations highlighting tracking, import, and layout limitations

observations.interpretation: Observed email interactions reflect delivered messages with qualifying human clicks, excluding known bot activity and collapsing repeat clicks by message identifier.
Landing sessions capture eligible durations surpassing the threshold alongside multi-page views or registrations.
Registration metrics measure eligible landing sessions resulting in a registration, subject to known visibility issues on mobile viewports.
Attendance tracking tallies distinct registered webinar and person pairs with positive attendee time, collapsing rejoins and excluding presenters.

actions: Review and add explicit mapping for unmapped campaign tags in web exports, preserving original raw tags while noting reclassification recovers attributable records without creating new audience activity.
Skip identical file imports by checking hashes and count webinar and person pairs rather than raw attendance rows, allowing exact file deduplication while quarantining conflicting event IDs.

Edit WordPress landing page asset metadata to address hidden registration actions at narrow widths, publish changes, and run fresh mobile test journeys acknowledging historical conversion rates remain unchanged.
